risks.title: Goodwill and Intangible Assets Impairment Risk
risks.score_rationale: The risk is discussed in detail in the Goodwill and Other Acquired Intangible Assets section, with quantitative and qualitative annual analyses. The text emphasizes that changes in assumptions could result in material impairment charges. The Capital category is highly weighted in case of significant impairment affecting overall financial health. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Critical Accounting Estimates Uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: Multiple accounting estimates (goodwill, taxes, pensions) are qualified as critical and depend on subjective judgments. The text specifies that different outcomes could have a material impact. The risk is recurring and central to financial statement management. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Income Tax Examination Risks
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned in the Income Taxes section, with provisions for uncertain tax positions. The language indicates there could be a material impact on results. The complexity of multinational audits increases potential severity. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Long-lived Assets Impairment Risk
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the Impairment of Long-lived Assets section. Assessment depends on assumptions about future cash flows and discount rates. While less central than goodwill, it concerns significant assets such as internal software and equipment. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Pension and Retirement Obligations Uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: Assumptions about future returns, salary levels and discount rates are critical. The text indicates that expenses and liabilities depend heavily on these estimates. A deviation could materially impact results and financial position. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Litigation and Regulatory Contingencies
risks.score_rationale: The Contingencies section indicates that losses are difficult to predict, especially with significant damages or novel legal theories. The risk is characterized as unpredictable, with potential for material impact on operations and finances. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: Moody's embed decision-grade intelligence powered by data and analytics into customer workflows. AI and advanced analytics are mentioned as enabling technologies for risk assessment and decision solutions, though not as a primary strategic pillar in the current 10-K.
evidence: Embedding decision-grade intelligence directly into customer workflows
